name: Card 玻璃卡片

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: Floating glass container holding grouped content; two material variants Regular (adaptive) and Clear (more transparent).

material: glass Regular (adaptive tint + full light response)
glass Clear (higher transparency, media-rich backgrounds, needs dimming)

representativeVariants.name: Regular glass card
representativeVariants.whySelected: Standard floating card — translucent white fill over backdrop blur with saturate boost, hairline border, specular top highlight

representativeVariants.name: Clear glass card
representativeVariants.whySelected: More transparent variant for media-heavy content; readability relies on an internal dimming layer

usageHints.glassRule: Cards float above the wallpaper; never place a glass card on another glass layer — content areas stay non-glass

doNotInvent: no opaque solid cards for elevated surfaces
unknowns: exact blur radius is an approximation of the native material
keyInsightSeed: Regular/Clear dual glass materials with hairline border and specular highlight
